zh.title: FAA要求部分波音737 NG定期檢測自動飛控系統
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署因應自動油門監控可能失效的風險，要求部分波音737 NG客機定期執行數位飛控系統測試，發現異常時須排除故障。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）發布適航指令2026-23-04，要求營運業者對部分波音737-600、737-700、737-700C、737-800及737-900定期執行數位飛控系統的測試。FAA估計，指令影響約300架美國註冊飛機，將在聯邦公報刊登後15天生效。
FAA指出，擾流板位置感測資料可能遺失或出錯，造成自動油門的巡航推力差監控功能無法啟動。兩具引擎的推力若因此出現明顯差距，飛機可能意外滾轉，若機組員未能及時察覺並修正，可能失去控制。
指令要求業者重複執行副翼內建測試，並按測試結果完成必要的修正及複測。適用機隊以波音安全通告所列航機為準。

en.title: FAA orders recurring flight-control tests on affected Boeing 737 NG aircraft
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration is requiring recurring flight-control tests on certain Boeing 737 NG aircraft to address a fault that could disable an autothrottle monitor.
body: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration has issued airworthiness directive 2026-23-04 for certain Boeing 737-600, 737-700, 737-700C, 737-800 and 737-900 aircraft. The FAA estimates it affects 300 U.S.-registered airplanes. It takes effect 15 days after publication in the Federal Register.

The FAA says missing or faulty spoiler-position data could prevent the autothrottle’s cruise thrust split monitor from activating. A large difference in engine thrust could then cause an unexpected roll, with a risk of loss of control if the crew does not identify and correct the condition in time.

Operators must perform recurring aileron built-in tests on the digital flight-control system and carry out corrective actions and retesting as applicable. The Boeing safety advisory referenced by the directive identifies the affected aircraft.

facts.claim: The directive applies to specified 737-600, -700, -700C, -800 and -900 aircraft and requires repetitive aileron built-in tests.
The FAA estimates about 300 U.S.-registered aircraft are affected.
